title: Routinely Schedule Import
description:
Schema for importing templates and weekly schedule into the Routinely app.

Routinely is a personal time-tracking and routine-testing Android app. The core idea is that the user has a daily routine with activities scheduled throughout the week, and they want to time each activity to see if their planned time allocations are realistic.

How it works:
- The user creates Session Templates (e.g., 'Workout - Chest Day', 'Lunch', 'Study - Algorithms')
- Each template has ordered Sub-Activities (e.g., 'Warm Up' → 'Bench Press' → 'Dumbbell Flys' → 'Cool Down')
- Templates are assigned to days of the week via the Weekly Schedule
- When the user starts a session, a stopwatch runs for each sub-activity sequentially with a configurable rest countdown between them
- The user can pause at any time (e.g., bathroom break) and the pause time is tracked separately
- Each sub-activity and session can have an expected duration for comparison
- After finishing all sessions for the day, the user exports a CSV with all timing data
- History tracks all past sessions, showing trends and comparisons over time

Key concepts:
- Templates can have Tags for categorization (e.g., 'fitness', 'meals', 'productivity')
- expectedMinutes is optional but valuable — it lets the user compare actual vs planned time
- restSeconds is the countdown between sub-activities (default 30 seconds). Set to 0 for activities that flow directly into each other
- The schedule maps templates to days of the week. A template can appear on multiple days
- Template names must be unique — if a template with the same name already exists in the app, it will be skipped during import

When generating a schedule for the user:
- Ask them about their weekly routine, what activities they do on which days
- Break each activity into logical sub-steps they'd want to time individually
- Set realistic expectedMinutes based on the activity type
- Use appropriate restSeconds (60s for heavy exercises, 30s for light ones, 0 for non-exercise activities)
- Assign tags to group related templates
- The schedule should reflect their actual week — only include days they're active

templates.description: List of session templates to create. If a template with the same name already exists, it will be skipped.

name.description: Template name, e.g. 'Workout - Chest Day', 'Lunch', 'Study - Algorithms'. Must be unique.

expectedMinutes.description: Optional expected total duration in minutes for the entire session. Used for comparing actual vs planned time.

tags.description: Optional tags to categorize this template, e.g. ['fitness', 'upper body']. Tags are created automatically if they don't exist.

activities.description: Ordered list of sub-activities within this session. These run sequentially — when one finishes, a rest countdown starts, then the next one begins automatically.

name.description: Activity name, e.g. 'Warm Up', 'Bench Press', 'Cool Down'

expectedMinutes.description: Optional expected duration for this specific activity in minutes

restSeconds.description: Rest duration in seconds before the next activity starts automatically. Use 60-90 for heavy exercises, 30 for light ones, 0 for activities that flow directly into each other. Default: 30

schedule.description: Weekly schedule mapping days to template names. Each day contains an ordered array of template names that should be done that day. Only include days that have activities planned.
